description: Defines a template class CalculatorVector that provides a wrapper around std::vector with additional methods for safe access, modification, and string representation, intended for use in calculator or expression evaluation contexts.

classes.name: CalculatorVector
classes.description: A template class that manages a vector of TType with methods for element access, modification, removal, insertion, truncation, appending, clearing, and converting to string.

methods.name: GetAt
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index, returning an error code if out of range.

methods.name: GetSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the vector.

methods.name: SetAt
methods.description: Sets the element at the specified index, returning an error if out of range.

methods.name: RemoveAt
methods.description: Removes the element at the specified index, returning an error if out of range.

methods.name: InsertAt
methods.description: Inserts an element at the specified index, handling memory allocation errors.

methods.name: Truncate
methods.description: Truncates the vector at the specified index.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends an element to the end of the vector.

methods.name: RemoveAtEnd
methods.description: Removes the last element from the vector.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the vector.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Converts the vector contents into a string representation.

methods.name: GetExpressionSuffix
methods.description: Provides a suffix string for the expression, defaulting to ' ='.
